title: Pricing cutover sprint: SKU mapping, limit gates, billing comms & sales enablement
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Coordinate the final sprint to migrate customers to the new SKU + limits model and ensure billing systems, release notes, and sales teams are ready. This ticket consolidates action items across billing, console, support, legal, and sales: finalize SKU mappings, set throttling and quota gates, finalize customer-facing billing copy, prepare sales enablement materials, schedule cutover windows and fallbacks, and validate post-cutover metrics and reconciliations.
acceptance_criteria: 1) All active SKUs mapped to new catalog and verified in staging environment; 2) Billing aggregation and invoices validated for 3 representative customers; 3) Release notes drafted and published to docs site + emailed to affected customers; 4) Sales enablement playbook and FAQ distributed and recorded; 5) Cutover runbook executed in sandbox without invoice divergence >0.5%; 6) Monitoring dashboards live and alerting on token delta and revenue variance.

comms_plan: Internal announcement: All-hands async doc + Slack #pricing at T-5 days (owner: PM)
Customer release notes: docs.redwood.ai/pricing-2025 and targeted email to customers in migration cohorts at T-3 days
Billing preview email: send to top 100 accounts with projected invoice delta and opt-in migration assistance
Support playbook: triage steps and escalation path in Confluence and Support Kanban (owner: Support)
sales_enablement_plan: 1-hour live training session and recorded runbook for AEs (owner: Sales Ops)
FAQ with sample billing scenarios and negotiation levers (uplift/coupon strategies)
Deal-level migration checklist for CSMs + templated email for executive outreach
Enablement scoreboard: track AE readiness and number of customers engaged
launch_steps: T-7 days: Lock SKU mapping spreadsheet and seed staging catalog
T-5 days: Publish internal runbook and comms timeline
T-3 days: Billing preview emails sent; sales enablement session recorded
Cutover day window 1 (low-risk cohort): run migration for sandbox accounts and validate invoices
Cutover day window 2 (tiered rollout): migrate 10% of low-touch customers
Cutover day window 3 (general availability): migrate remaining cohorts with monitoring and on-call rotations
Post-cutover +72h: reconciliation report and customer feedback triage
rollback_plan: If invoice variance > 0.5% across test cohort, trigger rollback to previous SKU mapping for affected customers
Rollback steps documented in runbook: revert catalog pointers, requeue billing jobs, notify Finance and Support
Hotline: create Zoom channel and Slack incident channel #pricing-cutover-incident for cross-team coordination
monitoring_and_metrics: Token usage delta by customer cohort (dashboard URL: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/pricing/token-delta)
Invoice variance (expected vs actual) by customer over 3 billing cycles
Number of billing-related support tickets and average time to resolution
Migration completion percent and open blockers per cohort
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Unexpected invoice deltas for a high-revenue customer — Mitigation: pre-migration billing previews + priority rollback
Risk: Console quota enforcement causes regressions in long-tail workloads — Mitigation: staged rollout + canary metrics and immediate feature flag toggle
Risk: Sales confusion on new entitlements — Mitigation: live enablement + downloadable cheat sheets + AE office hours
Risk: Legal/regulatory objections to TOS wording — Mitigation: Legal pre-review and templated comms
